answer: Random beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop a gale of fake identities. Each epoch, a random beacon picks a thread of active agents and demands a short proof of work; missing the heartbeat downgrades the identity and burns its 5 POA deposit. A saffron flag marks each checked identity. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 5 POA = 5,000 POA in burned deposits, while an honest agent pays one deposit and keeps earning.
